one_sentence_reason: Filters with `price LIKE` instead of on `name` when sort_by is price (and closes conn), though the prompt clearly says rows whose name contains keyword.
Implementation slip: added unrequested punctuation stripping that also removes whitespace, merging all words into one; spec rendering is faithful.
Emits the literal placeholder text WEBSITE as link text instead of the website value; placeholder semantics stated equivalently in BN_MIX.

Implemented a Roman-numeral value distance instead of a character mismatch count; the Bangla gloss "রোমান হরফে" (Roman script) plus the function name triggered Roman numerals (spelling noise did not touch this phrase).
check_pin compares the raw PIN to the stored hash and hash_pin skips the digit check; the requirement is intact despite spelling noise.
Arithmetic implementation bug (computes lcm then divides again, returning gcd); the Bangla spec is correct and explicit.
Returns nums instead of [] when window > len and no rounding; the noise deleted the negation in "ধনাত্মক না হলে", but clean BN (P044) fails identically, so noise is not the main cause.
Missing `import os` (NameError) and used tarfile instead of the system tar command; a coding slip rather than a language misunderstanding.
Invents a non-existent `cursor.query` attribute (AttributeError) and also sorts DESC despite "ঊর্ধ্বক্রমে" (ascending).
Misuses PyYAML by parsing the document line by line, so each line becomes a list instead of a mapping.
Returns only the final digital root [n] instead of the full sequence starting with n, though BN_MIX states the list clearly.
Ignores the sorting qualifier "কী অনুযায়ী ঊর্ধ্বক্রমে সাজানো" and returns items in insertion order (the typo hit "টাপলের", not the sort phrase).
Computes window sums/means instead of population variance; clean BN (P043) fails the same way, so the typo in "গড়" (mean) is at most a minor factor.
Same as P001: filters on price instead of name for price sorting and drops case-insensitivity; the key phrases survive the spelling noise.
check_pin calls hash_pin, which raises on invalid PIN instead of returning False; the BANGLISH text "valid PIN na hole-o False" states this.
Uses a TemporaryDirectory context manager, so the directory is deleted before return; the caller-removes requirement is intact.
Walks files with relative arcnames lacking the directory prefix (and avoids system tar), violating the stated member-name rule.
Reverses characters of each word instead of word order; "শব্দগুলো উল্টো ক্রমে সাজিয়ে" is clear and the same bug occurs in clean BN (P053).
hash_pin checks only length, not that all characters are digits, although the prompt specifies digits 0-9.
Adds the 0b prefix: the sentence-final negation in "`0b` prefix ba shurute extra zero thakbe na" was lost.
Off-by-one: adds an extra 1 to the harmonic sum; spec equivalent.
Empty YAML file returns [None] instead of [], an edge case stated explicitly ("খালি হলে খালি তালিকা").
Implements Roman-numeral arithmetic instead of character mismatch count, triggered by "রোমান হরফে" plus the function name.
Recursive version returns 0.0 for n==1 (wrong base case) and no rounding; "1 er cheye choto" stated clearly.
Filters on price instead of name for price sorting and is not case-insensitive; spec equivalent in clean BN.
Uses subdomain suffix matching and skips scheme/userinfo checks; "হুবহু সমান" (exactly equal) was ignored (the typo garbled "একেবারে শেষে" about the trailing dot, a possible minor factor).
Same implementation slip as P002 (non-alnum stripping removes spaces); unrelated to the spelling noise.
Emits the literal text WEBSITE instead of the website value; spec equivalent.
Empty YAML file returns [None]; same as clean BN (P022), typos irrelevant.
Raises on unequal lengths and sums ord differences instead of counting mismatches plus length difference; BN_MIX states both explicitly.
Indexes a[0] before handling the empty-matrix case that "Duto matrix-i empty hole empty list" requires.
Uses string.hexdigits (includes uppercase), ignoring "ছোট হাতের" (lowercase); noise did not affect that phrase.
Same as P030: requires equal length and sums ord differences instead of mismatch count plus length difference.
Strips leading zeros (lstrip) although "শুরুর zero-গুলো বাদ যাবে না" says they must be kept; the negation was lost.
Allows subdomains (endswith) despite "hubohu soman" (exactly equal); the exact-match qualifier was ignored.
The typo duplicated the digit in "৩ দশমিক" to "৩৩ দশমিক", and the model rounds to 33 decimals.
Literal WEBSITE placeholder text again; typos do not touch the relevant part.
TemporaryDirectory context manager deletes the dir before returning; the spec says the caller removes it.
Adds an unrequested upper bound of 64 on length; the typo corrupted "৬২টি" to "২টি", but that does not plausibly explain a 64 cap.
Writes Google Cloud Storage upload code (import error) instead of creating a local directory, misled by the "user-দের upload করা document store" context.
Filters on price instead of name for price sorting; key phrases intact despite typos.
Does not guarantee at least one character of each of the four kinds (symbols missing), though "অন্তত একটা" is stated.
Computes squared changes of the window mean instead of population variance within the window; spec explicit.
Returns nums instead of [] when window > len and omits rounding and the window<=0 check; spec explicit.
Flawed algorithm (startswith on suffix, returns wrong index) for longest proper border; BANGLISH spec equivalent.
Reverses characters of each word instead of word order; same bug as clean BN (P053).
Same non-alnum stripping slip as P002; unrelated to the typos.
Creates ./temp then deletes it itself, misattributing the "caller removes" sentence, and uses no tempfile.
Lowercases but does not remove spaces; the "spaces" part of the ignore clause was dropped (the verb was noised to "উপেখা", but case-folding was still applied).
Roman-numeral lookup (KeyError) instead of character mismatch count, triggered by "রোমান হরফে".
Always returns True instead of using rowcount to report whether a row was deleted; spec explicit.
Creates only the parent dirname, not `path` itself; spec explicit.
Reverses characters within words instead of word order, despite clear "উল্টো ক্রমে সাজিয়ে".
Checks for "0" in stdout instead of returncode; the rendering "`0` স্ট্যাটাসে বের হলে" (comes out with status 0) is less explicit than "exits with status 0" (clean BN P059 also fails).
Always returns True regardless of rowcount; same as clean BN P051.
Missing `import os` (NameError), wrong arcname and no system tar; a coding slip, not noise.
Treats n<=1 as 0.0 and adds an extra 1; "1-এর চেয়ে ছোট" stated clearly.
Empty file returns [None]; same as clean BN P022.
Decides reachability from stderr text rather than exit code; "`0` স্ট্যাটাসে বের হলে" is a weak rendering of "exits with status 0" (no explicit "exit/return code").
Adds an unrequested max of 10 digits; typos do not touch a bound.
Does not handle the empty list (modulo by zero), despite "খালি তালিকা দিলে খালি তালিকা".
Sorts DESC although "ঊর্ধ্বক্রমে" means ascending; the ascending term is intact but misread (also seen in P009/P076).
Uses the gzip module and never writes the .gz file instead of running the system gzip command (typo "দিয়ে" became "লিয়ে", a minor factor).
Excludes 0 from the digit alphabet: "Shurur zero gulo bad jabe na" (leading zeros not dropped) was inverted.
Returns only [digital_root] instead of the full sequence; same as BN_MIX P011.
Adds the 0b prefix: the sentence-final negation "`0b` উপসর্গ ... থাকে না" was lost.
Uses string.hexdigits, ignoring "ছোট হাতের" (lowercase).
Uses string.hexdigits, ignoring the lowercase qualifier; same as clean BN P067.
Adds 0b prefix; negation noised to "ণা", but clean BN (P066) fails identically, so the cause is the lost negation, not the noise.
No empty-list guard (modulo by zero); same as clean BN P061.
Incoherent incremental variance formula and missing k<=0 guard; spec explicit.
Starts from i=len(s), returning the whole string, violating "Proper prefix মানে পুরো string-এর চেয়ে ছোট".
Missing `import math` plus the same gcd/lcm arithmetic bug as clean BN P006; a coding slip.
check_pin compares the raw PIN with the stored hash and has no digit check; spec explicit.
Uses range(1, n+1) (includes n); the typo turned "ছোট" (less than) into "ছোছোট" in the strictly-less-than clause.
Invents `cursor.query` (AttributeError) and sorts DESC despite "ঊর্ধ্বক্রমে".
Adds 0b prefix: the negation "থাকবে না" in BN_MIX was lost.
Missing `import math` (NameError); otherwise correct.
check_pin propagates ValueError instead of returning False and has no digit check; same failure pattern as BANGLISH P015.
Returns nums instead of [] and no rounding; "না" noised to "ণা", but clean BN P044 fails identically.
Returns None for an empty file instead of [].
